title: Happy Digger Go-Go
description:
Dig deep, sell shiny stuff, upgrade your happy little robot.

In Happy Digger Go-Go, you play as a cheerful little digger bot exploring underground tunnels, collecting minerals, and bringing them back to the surface to sell for cash.

The deeper you dig, the more valuable the minerals become — but you’ll need to keep upgrading your bot if you want to survive longer trips underground.

Dig, sell, upgrade, repeat!

Mine your way through dirt, stone, and buried treasure. Return to the surface, sell what you found, and spend your earnings on useful upgrades to help you dig deeper next time.

Upgrade your digger bot.

Improve your little robot with better equipment, stronger digging power, bigger storage, and other upgrades that make each trip underground more rewarding.

Make your bot your own

Unlock cosmetics and customise your digger bot with different looks as you play.

Bring a little friend along

Collect cute pets that can join you on your digging adventures.

Features

[*]Play as a happy little digger bot

[*]Dig underground and collect minerals

[*]Sell minerals for money

[*]Buy upgrades to dig deeper and last longer

[*]Unlock cosmetics for your bot

[*]Collect pets to follow you around

[*]Simple, cheerful mining gameplay

[*]A cute 2D digging adventure

Happy Digger Go-Go is a cosy little mining game about digging deeper, finding better minerals, and slowly turning your little bot into the best digger around.
description_short: Play as a happy little digger bot, mine underground for minerals, sell your haul, buy upgrades, unlock cosmetics, collect pets, and dig deeper each run in this cute 2D mining adventure.
